pairs: Et introduxit me in templum,
And he led me into the temple,
et mensus est frontes: sex cubitos latitudinis hinc,
and he measured the front to be six cubits in width on one side,
et sex cubitos latitudinis inde,
and six cubits in width on the other side,
latitudinem tabernaculi.
which is the width of the tabernacle.
Et latitudo portæ decem cubitorum erat:
And the width of the gate was ten cubits.
et latera portæ, quinque cubitis hinc,
And the sides of the gate were five cubits on one side,
et quinque cubitis inde: et mensus est longitudinem ejus quadraginta cubitorum,
and five cubits on the other side. And he measured its length to be forty cubits,
et latitudinem viginti cubitorum.
and the width to be twenty cubits.
Et introgressus intrinsecus, mensus est in fronte portæ duos cubitos:
And proceeding inward, he measured the front of the gate to be two cubits.
et portam, sex cubitorum:
And the gate was six cubits,
et latitudinem portæ septem cubitorum.
and the width of the gate was seven cubits.
Et mensus est longitudinem ejus viginti cubitorum,
And he measured its length to be twenty cubits,
et latitudinem ejus viginti cubitorum,
and its width to be twenty cubits,
ante faciem templi.
before the face of the temple.
Et dixit ad me:
And he said to me,
Hoc est Sanctum sanctorum.
“This is the Holy of Holies.”
Et mensus est parietem domus sex cubitorum:
And he measured the wall of the house to be six cubits,
et latitudinem lateris quatuor cubitorum undique per circuitum domus.
and the width of the sides to be four cubits, all around the house on every side.
Latera autem,
Now the side chambers were side by side,
latus ad latus,
and twice thirty-three.
bis triginta tria:
And they projected outward,
et erant eminentia,
so that they might enter along the wall of the house,
quæ ingrederentur per parietem domus,
on the sides all around,
in lateribus per circuitum,
in order to contain,
ut continerent,
but not touch,
et non attingerent parietem templi.
the wall of the temple.
Et platea erat in rotundum,
And there was a broad circular path,
ascendens sursum per cochleam, et in cœnaculum templi deferebat per gyrum:
rising upward by winding, and it led to the cenacle of the temple by a circular course.
idcirco latius erat templum in superioribus:
As a result, the temple was wider in the higher parts. And so,
et sic de inferioribus ascendebatur ad superiora in medium.
from the lower parts, they rose up to the higher parts, in the center.
Et vidi in domo altitudinem per circuitum,
And in the house, I saw the height all around the foundations of the side chambers,
fundata latera ad mensuram calami sex cubitorum spatio:
which were the measure of a reed, the space of six cubits.
et latitudinem per parietem lateris forinsecus quinque cubitorum:
And the width of the exterior wall for the side chambers was five cubits.
et erat interior domus in lateribus domus.
And the inner house was within the side chambers of the house.
Et inter gazophylacia latitudinem viginti cubitorum in circuitu domus undique,
And between the storerooms, there was the width of twenty cubits, all around the house on every side.
et ostium lateris ad orationem:
And the door of the side chambers was toward the place of prayer.
ostium unum ad viam aquilonis,
One door was toward the way of the north,
et ostium unum ad viam australem:
and one door was toward the way of the south.
et latitudinem loci ad orationem, quinque cubitorum in circuitu.
And the width of the place for prayer was five cubits all around.
Et ædificium,
And the edifice,
quod erat separatum,
which was separate,
versumque ad viam respicientem ad mare, latitudinis septuaginta cubitorum:
and which verged toward the way looking toward the sea, was seventy cubits in width.
paries autem ædificii, quinque cubitorum latitudinis per circuitum:
But the wall of the edifice was five cubits in width on all sides,
et longitudo ejus nonaginta cubitorum.
and its length was ninety cubits.
Et mensus est domus longitudinem,
And he measured the length of the house to be one hundred cubits,
centum cubitorum:
and the edifice,
et quod separatum erat ædificium,
which was separate,
et parietes ejus,
with its walls,
longitudinis centum cubitorum.
to be one hundred cubits in length.
Latitudo autem ante faciem domus,
Now the width before the face of the house,
et ejus quod erat separatum contra orientem,
and of that which was separate facing the east,
centum cubitorum.
was one hundred cubits.
Et mensus est longitudinem ædificii contra faciem ejus,
And he measured the length of the edifice opposite its face,
quod erat separatum ad dorsum:
which was separated at the back,
ethecas ex utraque parte centum cubitorum:
and the porticos on both sides,
et templum interius,
to be one hundred cubits,
et vestibula atrii.
with the inner temple and the vestibules of the court.
Limina, et fenestras obliquas,
The thresholds, and the oblique windows,
et ethecas in circuitu per tres partes,
and the porticoes, encircling it on three sides,
contra uniuscujusque limen,
were opposite the threshold of each one,
stratumque ligno per gyrum in circuitu:
and were floored with wood throughout the entire area.
terra autem usque ad fenestras,
But the floor reached even to the windows,
et fenestræ clausæ super ostia.
and the windows were closed above the doors;
Et usque ad domum interiorem,
and it reached even to the inner house,
et forinsecus per omnem parietem in circuitu,
and to the exterior,
intrinsecus
throughout the entire wall,
et forinsecus,
all around the interior and exterior,
ad mensuram.
for the entire extent.
Et fabrefacta cherubim et palmæ:
And there were cherubim and palm trees wrought,
et palma inter cherub et cherub,
and each palm tree was between one cherub and another,
duasque facies habebat cherub.
and every cherub had two faces.
Faciem hominis juxta palmam ex hac parte,
The face of a man was closest to the palm tree on one side,
et faciem leonis juxta palmam ex alia parte:
and the face of a lion was closest to the palm tree on the other side.
expressam per omnem domum in circuitu.
This was depicted throughout the entire house all around.
De terra usque ad superiora portæ,
From the floor,
cherubim
even to the upper parts of the gate,
et palmæ cælatæ erant in pariete templi.
there were cherubim and palm trees engraved in the wall of the temple.
Limen quadrangulum, et facies sanctuarii, aspectus contra aspectum.
The square threshold and the face of the sanctuary were one sight facing the other.
Altaris lignei trium cubitorum altitudo,
The altar of wood was three cubits in height,
et longitudo ejus duorum cubitorum:
and its length was two cubits.
et anguli ejus,
And its corners,
et longitudo ejus,
and its length,
et parietes ejus lignei.
and its walls were of wood.
Et locutus est ad me:
And he said to me,
Hæc est mensa coram Domino.
“This is the table in the sight of the Lord.”
Et duo ostia erant in templo et in sanctuario.
And there were two doors in the temple and in the sanctuary.
Et in duobus ostiis ex utraque parte bina erant ostiola quæ in se invicem plicabantur: bina enim ostia erant ex utraque parte ostiorum.
And in the two doors, on both sides, were two little doors, which were folded within each other. For two doors were on both sides of the doors.
Et cælata erant in ipsis ostiis templi cherubim,
And cherubim were engraved in the same doors of the temple,
et sculpturæ palmarum,
with the figures of palm trees,
sicut in parietibus quoque expressæ erant:
as were depicted also on the walls.
quam ob rem
For this reason also,
et grossiora erant ligna in vestibuli fronte forinsecus.
the boards were thicker in the front of the vestibule on the exterior.
Super quæ fenestræ obliquæ,
Upon these were the oblique windows,
et similitudo palmarum hinc
with the representation of palm trees on one side as well as on the other,
atque inde in humerulis vestibuli,
at the sides of the vestibule,
secundum latera domus,
in accord with the sides of the house,
latitudinemque parietum.
and the width of the walls.
